title: How does local storage backup work?
intent: This article explains how browser localStorage backs up in-progress survey answers.
short_answer: EUSurvey automatically saves answer progress to browser localStorage. If the browser crashes, respondents can restore their answers when returning to the survey.
procedure: Answers are automatically backed up as you fill them in.
If the page crashes or closes, return to the survey URL.
A prompt offers to restore from backup.
important_conditions: Restore prompt appears if backup exists.
Can be disabled for shared computers.
Uploaded files cannot be restored from backup.
troubleshooting: Local storage disabled message: Enable localStorage in browser.
Files not restored: File uploads cannot be saved in localStorage.
